Messages.Author: Mochuda
Messages.Body:
i thought this was discussed before but i'm unable to find it

let's get to the following situation

I've played a Fame on a minion A controlled by whoever (my prey for instance
:-P)
This minion is then banished by a (helpful ?) friend and go to the
uncontrolled region

Can I then play another copy of Fame on another minion B ?

i guess yes as the first Fame is now out of play

if yes, what happens if minion A is reinfluenced out ?

a/ as i can't selfcontest, the incoming copy of Fame is burned and minion B
keeps its uncontested Fame as it is
b/ the 2 Fames contest and I have to wait my untap phase to yield one and
keep the other one
c/ something else

i would say a/ but better check

thx
Mochuda
